item.title: More RFML
item.description: In an earlier post, I introduced one of the classic entry points into radio frequency machine learning: converting RF data into spectrograms and then applying a convolutional neural network. That workflow is still useful, especially for rapid prototyping and for problems where time-frequency structure is highly informative. But RF machine learning has moved well beyond that first generation of image-style pipelines.
